title: Synchronize dependent profile state after manual historical-family selection
requirements: Construction must carry provenance: FAMILY_DEFAULT, DIRECT_EVIDENCE, AUTO_CLASSIFICATION, IMPORTED_PHYSICS, USER_EXPLICIT_OVERRIDE, or UNKNOWN_FALLBACK.
A stale/default value must never silently outrank a manually selected historical family.
Selecting 1966 World Sportscar / Group 4-6 FAM022 must select the family cross-ply/bias-ply construction unless the user explicitly overrides it.
Size notation must never determine carcass construction.
Cross-field validation must block contradictory family/construction generation.

title: Separate cumulative, session, stint and tire-set distance
requirements: Reset or derive SESSION_DISTANCE per session.
Reset or derive STINT_DISTANCE per stint.
Reset or derive CURRENT_TIRE_SET_DISTANCE per tire set.
Wear-analysis exports must state which distance basis they use.

title: Redesign pressure prediction using clean A/B calibration fixtures
requirements: Preserve Escort corrected-pressure A/B as the clean reference fixture.
Preserve GT40 as architecture regression only; do not fit exact GT40 coefficients from the contaminated construction.
A prediction with observed hot closure errors of roughly 3-5 psi must not be classified GOOD.
Keep pressure calibration separate from thermal target calibration and global carcass stiffness.

title: Retest Thermal V2 only after construction and pressure corrections
requirements: Do not apply a global historic-tire thermal multiplier.
Do not tune FAM022 from the radial-contaminated GT40 run.
Preserve Escort temperature channel semantics and the unresolved historical optimum.
Regenerate and test multiple correctly constructed families before changing surface/carcass/core transfer coefficients.
